race.comment: BLUE EYED BRIGID (6) sets the standard after two placings this campaign, most recently second at Hawkesbury when an odds-on favourite on soft ground. She is third-up, gets weight relief and has already shown she is effective around 1600m. Make plenty of appeal with Lloyd retaining the ride. INCEPTION (10) has been around the mark without winning, but his Port Macquarie fourth in a Class 3 had merit after beginning awkwardly when shouldering the 59kg. Proven at the trip and gets a better setup. FEDERAL RESERVE (1) struck a bit of trouble at the start from the wide gate when ninth in a BM72 at Rosehill over 1400m. Proven at the trip and gets map favours. GRUNGE (4) returns from a five-week freshening after fading in the straight with a dismal last over 1800m at Hawkesbury.  Back to his preferred trip and won here two back over this trip. Improver.
